akhfash:1-2.t: ﴿لإِيلاَفِ قُرَيْشٍ﴾, that is: He did that for the bringing together (īlāf) of Quraysh, for (their) uniting (لتألّف); then He substituted (with a badal) and said ﴿إِيلاَفِهِمْ رِحْلَةَ ٱلشِّتَآءِ وَٱلصَّيْفِ﴾, because it is from "أَلَفَ"*. And some read ﴿لإِيلاَفِ﴾, taking it from "آلَفُوا". «[Translator's note: the two readings are printed identically in the source, so the difference between them is not visible in the text as transmitted.]»
